params.name: ProgramId
params.description: The ID of the program to retrieve tasks from.

params.name: Type
params.description: Filter tasks by one or more comma-separated task types. For compliance violations, use COMPLIANCE. Values match the Type field in the Task response.

params.name: SubtypeName
params.description: Filter tasks by one or more comma-separated subtype names. Requires the Type parameter. For compliance violations, common values are Search, Promo, Social, and Content. Passing an unrecognized subtype returns a validation error.

params.name: DateCreatedAfter
params.description: Only return tasks created on or after this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: DateCreatedBefore
params.description: Only return tasks created on or before this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: DateLastUpdatedBefore
params.description: Only return tasks updated before this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: DateLastUpdatedAfter
params.description: Only return tasks updated after this date (ISO 8601).

items.docs: Returns a list of existing, non-archived tasks for a specific program.

params.name: TaskId
params.description: The unique identifier for the task.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of an existing task by its unique ID.
